# List-marker fixture

- ordinary star form
* ordinary asterisk form
+ ordinary plus form
- [ ] open task
- [x] completed task

  - nested ordinary item with enough body text to wrap beside its marker on a narrow writing measure and keep the continuation aligned
  - [ ] nested open task with enough body text to wrap beside its marker on a narrow writing measure and keep the continuation aligned
    - nested level-two ordinary item
    - [x] nested completed task

- [] invalid task syntax remains ordinary list text
1. ordered neighbor
2. second ordered neighbor
